verdict.rationale: Team sharing, organizations and role-based permissions are a fair question for a SaaS scraping API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only API parameters, dedicated APIs, a CLI, an MCP server and an account-level usage API. Nothing shows teammate sharing of scrapers, organization management or role-based access control.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share scrapers with teammates and manage organizations and role-based permissions
